svt_mipi_dsi_packet Class Reference

Inheritance diagram for class svt_mipi_dsi_packet:

List of all members.

Detailed Description

This is the base transaction type which contains protocol attributes like packet direction, packet type, transmission mode, packet kind packet delay, checksum, ECC etc. It also contains a handle to configuration object of type svt_mipi_dsi_configuration , that provides the configuration of various field like ECC, CRC, Bus Turnaround. This helps in generating the random values of such fields.

  function string
 svt_mipi_dsi_packet::psdisplay_short
 (  string prefix = "", bit hdr_only = 0  ) 

Returns a string (with no line feeds) that reports the essential contents of the packet generally necessary to uniquely identify that packet.

prefix - (Optional: default = "") The string given in this argument becomes the first item listed in the value returned. It is intended to be used to identify the transactor (or other source) that requested this string. This argument should be limited to 8 characters or less (to accommodate the fixed column widths in the returned string). If more than 8 characters are supplied, only the first 8 characters are used.

hdr_only - (Optional: default = 0) If this argument is supplied, and is '1', the function returns a 3-line table header string, which indicates which packet data appears in the subsequent columns. If this argument is '1', the prefix argument becomes the column label for the first header column (still subject to the 8 character limit).

This is a non-rand bit variable which is used to send EOT to terminate continuous clock mode in DSI-CPHY

 bit  attribute

Indicates if sixth,eighth,ninth and 10th bits of the sync pattern starting from 0th bit are set to 1.
  • Incase of sync pattern sixth bit of the sync pattern and first,second and third bits of first data payload will be checked.
  • Incase of skew sync pattern sixth,eighth,ninth and tenth bits of the skew sync pattern will be checked.

  constraint
 svt_mipi_dsi_packet::reasonable_bta_active

For using bta_active signal.
constraint reasonable_bta_active {
     ((forward_data_id == VSYNC_START || forward_data_id == VSYNC_END ||
       forward_data_id == HSYNC_START || forward_data_id == HSYNC_END ||
       forward_data_id == COLOR_MODE_OFF || forward_data_id == COLOR_MODE_ON ||
       forward_data_id == SHUT_DOWN || forward_data_id == TURN_ON ||
       forward_data_id == NULL_PACKET || forward_data_id == BLANKING_PACKET ||
       forward_data_id == GEN_WRITE0 || forward_data_id == GEN_WRITE1 ||
       forward_data_id == GEN_WRITE2 || forward_data_id == DCS_WRITE0 ||
       forward_data_id == DCS_WRITE1 || forward_data_id == SET_MAX_RTN_PKT_SIZE ||
       forward_data_id == GEN_LONG_WRITE || forward_data_id == DCS_LONG_WRITE ||
       forward_data_id == RESERVED || forward_data_id == PACKED_PIXEL_565 ||
       forward_data_id == COMPRESSION_MODE || forward_data_id == EXECUTE_QUEUE ||
       forward_data_id == COMPRESSED_IMAGE_DATA_TYPE || forward_data_id == PICTURE_PARAMETER_SET ||
       forward_data_id == PACKED_PIXEL_666 || forward_data_id == LOOSELY_PACKED_PIXEL_666 ||
       forward_data_id == PACKED_PIXEL_888 || forward_data_id == LOOSELY_PACKED_PIXEL_20BITS_YCBCR_422 ||
       forward_data_id == PACKED_PIXEL_24BITS_YCBCR_422 || forward_data_id == PACKED_PIXEL_16BITS_YCBCR_422 ||
       forward_data_id == PACKED_PIXEL_30BITS_RGB_101010 || forward_data_id == PACKED_PIXEL_36BITS_RGB_121212 ||
       forward_data_id == PACKED_PIXEL_12BITS_YCBCR_420) && dsi_cfg.bta_enable == 1'b1)
       -> bta_active dist { 2'h0 := 90,
                            2'h1 := 10};
     ((forward_data_id == GEN_READ0 || forward_data_id == GEN_READ1 ||
       forward_data_id == GEN_READ2 || forward_data_id == DCS_READ0) && dsi_cfg.bta_enable == 1'b1)
       -> bta_active == 2'h1;
  }

  constraint
 svt_mipi_dsi_packet::reasonable_data_payload_for_dcs_long_write

For using DCS command set_column_address, set_page_address, set_partial_column, set_partial_row, set_tear_scanline, set_scroll_area, write_lut, write_memory_start, write_memory_continue, set_3d_control using dcs_long_write command.
constraint reasonable_data_payload_for_dcs_long_write {
   foreach(data_payload[i])
    {
      (forward_data_id == DCS_LONG_WRITE && i == 0) -> (data_payload[i] inside {
            SET_TEAR_SCANLINE, SET_COLUMN_ADDRESS, SET_PAGE_ADDRESS,
            SET_PARTIAL_COLUMNS, SET_PARTIAL_ROWS, SET_SCROLL_AREA,
            WRITE_LUT, WRITE_MEMORY_START, WRITE_MEMORY_CONTINUE,
            SET_3D_CONTROL, SET_SCROLL_START
            });
    }
  }

  constraint
 svt_mipi_dsi_packet::reasonable_data_payload_for_dcs_mem_command

For using DCS command set_column_address, set_page_address,set_3d_control, set_partial_column, set_partial_row using dcs_long_write command.
constraint reasonable_data_payload_for_dcs_mem_command {
    foreach(data_payload[i])
    {
      if(forward_data_id == DCS_LONG_WRITE && i == 0) {
        (data_payload[i] == SET_SCROLL_AREA ) -> (data_payload.size() >=7 &&
        ({data_payload[(i+1)],data_payload[(i+2)],data_payload[(i+3)],data_payload[(i+4)],data_payload[(i+5)],data_payload[(i+6)]} <= 32'd4095));
        (data_payload[i] == SET_3D_CONTROL ) -> ( data_payload.size() >=3 &&(data_payload[(i+1)] == {2'b00,dsi_3d_lr_order,dsi_3d_vsync_type,dsi_3d_image_format,dimensional_type}) && (data_payload[(i+2)] == 8'h00));
        ((data_payload[i] == SET_COLUMN_ADDRESS || data_payload[i] == SET_PAGE_ADDRESS ||
         data_payload[i] == SET_PARTIAL_COLUMNS || data_payload[i] == SET_PARTIAL_ROWS))
         -> ( data_payload.size() >=5 && ({data_payload[(i+3)],data_payload[(i+4)]} <= 32'd4095) && ({data_payload[(i+1)],data_payload[(i+2)]} < {data_payload[(i+3)],data_payload[(i+4)]}));
         (data_payload[i] == SET_TEAR_SCANLINE || data_payload[i] == SET_SCROLL_START)
         -> ( data_payload.size() >=3);
      }
    }
  }

  constraint
 svt_mipi_dsi_packet::reasonable_data_word_count

Reasonable constraint for word count data.
constraint reasonable_data_word_count {
    forward_data_id == PICTURE_PARAMETER_SET -> data_word_count == 128;
    forward_data_id == DCS_READ0 -> data_word_count[15:8] == 8'h0;
    (forward_data_id == GEN_LONG_WRITE || forward_data_id == NULL_PACKET ||
     forward_data_id == BLANKING_PACKET || forward_data_id == SET_MAX_RTN_PKT_SIZE) ->
    data_word_count dist { [1:63] := DATA_WORD_CNT_FOR_LONG_PKT_1_63_wt
                          ,[64:127] := DATA_WORD_CNT_FOR_LONG_PKT_64_127_wt
                          ,[128: 3071] := DATA_WORD_CNT_FOR_LONG_PKT_128_1023_wt
    };
    (forward_data_id == SET_MAX_RTN_PKT_SIZE) ->
    data_word_count dist { [1:63] := DATA_WORD_CNT_FOR_LONG_PKT_1_63_wt
                           ,[64:127] := DATA_WORD_CNT_FOR_LONG_PKT_64_127_wt
                           ,[128: 3071] := DATA_WORD_CNT_FOR_LONG_PKT_128_1023_wt
    };
    forward_data_id == DCS_LONG_WRITE ->
    data_word_count dist { [2:63] := DATA_WORD_CNT_FOR_LONG_PKT_1_63_wt
                          ,[64:127] := DATA_WORD_CNT_FOR_LONG_PKT_64_127_wt
                          ,[128: 3071] := DATA_WORD_CNT_FOR_LONG_PKT_128_1023_wt
    };
    (forward_data_id == PACKED_PIXEL_565 || forward_data_id == PACKED_PIXEL_666 ||
     forward_data_id == PACKED_PIXEL_888 || forward_data_id == LOOSELY_PACKED_PIXEL_666 || forward_data_id ==LOOSELY_PACKED_PIXEL_20BITS_YCBCR_422 ||
    forward_data_id == PACKED_PIXEL_24BITS_YCBCR_422 || forward_data_id == PACKED_PIXEL_16BITS_YCBCR_422 ||
    forward_data_id == PACKED_PIXEL_30BITS_RGB_101010 || forward_data_id == PACKED_PIXEL_36BITS_RGB_121212 ||
    forward_data_id == PACKED_PIXEL_12BITS_YCBCR_420 || forward_data_id == COMPRESSED_IMAGE_DATA_TYPE || forward_data_id == PICTURE_PARAMETER_SET) ->
     data_word_count dist { [1:127] := DATA_WORD_CNT_FOR_LONG_PKT_1_63_wt
                           ,[128:511] := DATA_WORD_CNT_FOR_LONG_PKT_64_127_wt
                           ,[512: 3071] := DATA_WORD_CNT_FOR_LONG_PKT_128_1023_wt
    };
    (packet_direction == REVERSE && packet_kind == LONG) ->
     data_word_count dist { [1:127] := DATA_WORD_CNT_FOR_LONG_PKT_1_63_wt
                           ,[128:511] := DATA_WORD_CNT_FOR_LONG_PKT_64_127_wt
                           ,[512: 3071] := DATA_WORD_CNT_FOR_LONG_PKT_128_1023_wt
    };
  }

  constraint
 svt_mipi_dsi_packet::reasonable_dcs_write1

For using DCS command set_gamma_curve, set_pixel_format and set_tear_on using dcs_write1 command.
constraint reasonable_dcs_write1 {
    if(forward_data_id == DCS_WRITE1)
    {
      (data_word_count[7:0] == SET_GAMMA_CURVE) -> data_word_count[15:8] inside {8'h00,8'h01,8'h02,8'h04,8'h08};
      (data_word_count[7:0] == SET_PIXEL_FORMAT) -> data_word_count[10:8] inside {3'h1,3'h2,3'h3,3'h5,3'h6,3'h7};
      (data_word_count[7:0] == SET_PIXEL_FORMAT) -> data_word_count[14:12] inside {3'h1,3'h2,3'h3,3'h5,3'h6,3'h7};
    }
  }

  constraint
 svt_mipi_dsi_packet::reasonable_drive_hs_idle

constraint reasonable_drive_hs_idle {
    if(transmission_mode != HS || dsi_cfg.protocol_independent_bfm_enable != 1) {
      drive_hs_idle == 0;
    } else {
      if((data_word_count / dsi_cfg.num_lanes) == 0) {
        drive_hs_idle == 0;
      }
    }
  }

  constraint
 svt_mipi_dsi_packet::reasonable_max_packet_delay

Reasonable constraint for maximum packet delay.
constraint reasonable_max_packet_delay {
     max_packet_delay == 10;
  }

  constraint
 svt_mipi_dsi_packet::reasonable_min_packet_delay

Reasonable constraint for minimum packet delay.
constraint reasonable_min_packet_delay {
     min_packet_delay == 0;
  }

  constraint
 svt_mipi_dsi_packet::reasonable_packet_direction

Reasonable constraint for packet direction.
constraint reasonable_packet_direction {
    if(dsi_cfg.device_type == svt_mipi_dsi_configuration::DSI_HOST) {
      packet_direction == FORWARD;
    }
    else {
      packet_direction == REVERSE;
    }
  }

  constraint
 svt_mipi_dsi_packet::reasonable_scrambling_disable

constraint reasonable_scrambling_disable {
    if(dsi_cfg.dsi_protocol_version == svt_mipi_dsi_configuration::DSI2_VERSION_10){
      (forward_data_id == SCRAMBLING_MODE_COMMAND) -> data_word_count[0] == 'h0;
    }
  }

  constraint
 svt_mipi_dsi_packet::reasonable_trigger_message

Reasonable constraint for trigger message.
constraint reasonable_trigger_message {
     transmission_mode == TRIGGER -> trigger_message != DSI_NONE;
     transmission_mode != TRIGGER -> trigger_message == DSI_NONE;
  }

  constraint
 svt_mipi_dsi_packet::reasonable_ulpm_clk_lane_active

Reasonable constraint for ulpm clock lane active.
constraint reasonable_ulpm_clk_lane_active {
     transmission_mode == ULPM -> ulpm_clk_lane_active == 1'b1;
     transmission_mode != ULPM -> ulpm_clk_lane_active == 1'b0;
  }

  constraint
 svt_mipi_dsi_packet::reasonable_vc_id

Reasonable constraint for generating valid VC ID value based on supported VC ID configuration. supported_vc_id is one-hot type representation of valid virtual channel.Ex: supported_vc_id = 4'h6 means virtual channels 1,2 enabled
constraint reasonable_vc_id {
    ((dsi_cfg.supported_vc_id) == 4'h1) -> (vc_id == 2'b00);
    ((dsi_cfg.supported_vc_id) == 4'h2) -> (vc_id == 2'b01);
    ((dsi_cfg.supported_vc_id) == 4'h3) -> (vc_id inside {2'b00,2'b01});
    ((dsi_cfg.supported_vc_id) == 4'h4) -> (vc_id == 2'b10);
    ((dsi_cfg.supported_vc_id) == 4'h5) -> (vc_id inside {2'b00,2'b10});
    ((dsi_cfg.supported_vc_id) == 4'h6) -> (vc_id inside {2'b01,2'b10});
    ((dsi_cfg.supported_vc_id) == 4'h7) -> (vc_id inside {2'b00,2'b01,2'b10});
    ((dsi_cfg.supported_vc_id) == 4'h8) -> (vc_id == 2'b11);
    ((dsi_cfg.supported_vc_id) == 4'h9) -> (vc_id inside {2'b00,2'b11});
    ((dsi_cfg.supported_vc_id) == 4'hA) -> (vc_id inside {2'b01,2'b11});
    ((dsi_cfg.supported_vc_id) == 4'hB) -> (vc_id inside {2'b00,2'b01,2'b11});
    ((dsi_cfg.supported_vc_id) == 4'hC) -> (vc_id inside {2'b10,2'b11});
    ((dsi_cfg.supported_vc_id) == 4'hD) -> (vc_id inside {2'b00,2'b10,2'b11});
    ((dsi_cfg.supported_vc_id) == 4'hE) -> (vc_id inside {2'b01,2'b10,2'b11});
    ((dsi_cfg.supported_vc_id) == 4'hF) -> (vc_id inside {2'b00,2'b01,2'b10,2'b11});
  }

  constraint
 svt_mipi_dsi_packet::reasonable_vsync_start

constraint reasonable_vsync_start {
     dsi_3d_image_format != RESERVED_3DFMT;
    dimensional_type != RESERVED_3DMODE;
   }

  constraint
 svt_mipi_dsi_packet::solve_order

valid constraint order of solving.
constraint solve_order {
    solve min_packet_delay before max_packet_delay;
    solve min_packet_delay before packet_delay;
    solve max_packet_delay before packet_delay;
    solve packet_kind before data_word_count,forward_data_id,reverse_data_id;
    solve packet_direction before forward_data_id, reverse_data_id,transmission_mode;
    solve packet_type before vc_id;
    solve forward_data_id before data_word_count,bta_active;
    solve reverse_data_id before data_word_count,bta_active;
    solve transmission_mode before packet_kind,packet_type,ulpm_clk_lane_active,trigger_message;
       solve data_word_count before data_payload.size();
    solve dsi_3d_payload_present before dimensional_type;
    solve dimensional_type before dsi_3d_image_format,dsi_3d_vsync_type,dsi_3d_lr_order;
    solve transmission_mode before drive_hs_idle;
  }

  constraint
 svt_mipi_dsi_packet::valid_ranges


valid constraint range for DSI packets fields.
  • max_packet_delay shall be greater than min_packet_delay.
  • Value of packet_delay shall be inside the range of min_packet_delay and max_packet_delay.
  • For FORWARD packet, reverse_data_id field shall be RESERVED_RESP.
  • For REVERSE packet, forward_data_id field shall be RESERVED and transmission mode will either be LPDT or TRIGGER.
  • bta_active will either be 2'b00 or 2'b01.
  • If bta_enable is 0, then bta_active is always 0.
  • For SHORT packet and LONG packet, forward_data_id and reverse_data_id should be as per specification.
  • data_word_count field:
    • For EOTP packet, data_word_count shall be 16'h0F0F.
    • If forward_data_id field inside VSYNC_START, VSYNC_END, HSYNC_START, HSYNC_END, COLOR_MODE_OFF, COLOR_MODE_ON, SHUT_DOWN, TURN_ON, GEN_WRITE0, GEN_READ0 then data_word_count shall be 00.
    • If forward_data_id field inside GEN_READ1, GEN_WRITE1, DCS_WRITE0 and DCS_READ0 then upper byte of data_word_count (data_word_count[15:8]) shall be 00.
    • If forward_data_id is DCS_WRITE0 then lower byte of data_word_count (data_word_count[7:0]) shall be inside ENTER_IDLE_MODE, ENTER_INVERT_MODE, ENTER_PARTIAL_MODE, ENTER_NORMAL_MODE, ENTER_SLEEP_MODE, EXIT_IDLE_MODE, EXIT_INVERT_MODE, EXIT_SLEEP_MODE, NOP, SET_DISPLAY_OFF, SET_DISPLAY_ON, SET_TEAR_OFF, SOFT_RESET.
    • If forward_data_id is DCS_WRITE0 then lower byte of data_word_count (data_word_count[7:0]) shall be inside SET_ADDRESS_MODE, SET_GAMMA_CURVE, SET_PIXEL_FORMAT, SET_TEAR_ON.
    • If forward_data_id is DCS_READ0 then lower byte of data_word_count (data_word_count[7:0]) shall be inside GET_BLUE_CHANNEL, GET_ADDRESS_MODE, GET_DIAGNOSTIC_RESULT, GET_DISPLAY_MODE, GET_GREEN_CHANNEL, GET_PIXEL_FORMAT, GET_POWER_MODE, GET_RED_CHANNEL, GET_SCAN_LINE, GET_SIGNAL_MODE, READ_DDB_START, READ_DDB_CONTINUE, READ_MEMORY_START, READ_MEMORY_CONTINUE, GET_3D_CONTROL, GET_IMAGE_CHECKSUM_RGB.
    • If forward_data_id is PACKED_PIXEL_565 then data_word_count shall be in multiple of 2.
    • If forward_data_id is PACKED_PIXEL_666 then data_word_count shall be in multiple of 9.
    • If forward_data_id is either PACKED_PIXEL_888 or LOOSELY_PACKED_PIXEL_666 then data_word_count shall be in multiple of 3.
  • For ULPM and TRIGGER transmission mode below fields have fixed value.
    • packet_kind == SHORT
    • data_word_count == 16'h0
    • ecc_value == 8'h0
    • crc_value == 16'h0
    • forward_data_id == RESERVED
    • reverse_data_id == RESERVED_RESP
    • packet_type == NORMAL
constraint valid_ranges {
    max_packet_delay > min_packet_delay;
     packet_delay inside {[min_packet_delay : max_packet_delay]};
     if(dsi_cfg.ulpm_entry_exit_mode == svt_mipi_dsi_configuration::ULPM_ENTRY_AND_EXIT || this.dsi_cfg.phy_type == svt_mipi_dsi_configuration::CPHY) {
      ulpm_entry_exit_type == ULPM_ENTRY_AND_EXIT;
    } else {
      ulpm_entry_exit_type inside {ULPM_ENTRY, ULPM_EXIT};
    }
     if(dsi_cfg.dsi_protocol_version >= svt_mipi_dsi_configuration::DSI_VERSION_13 && this.dsi_cfg.phy_type == svt_mipi_dsi_configuration::DPHY)
    {
      transmission_mode inside { HS, ULPM, LPDT, TRIGGER,INITIAL_SKEW, PERIODIC_SKEW };
    }
    else
    {
      transmission_mode inside { HS, ULPM, LPDT, TRIGGER};
    }
    transmission_mode != ALTERNATE_CAL;
     (packet_direction == FORWARD) -> reverse_data_id == RESERVED_RESP;
    (packet_direction == REVERSE) -> forward_data_id == RESERVED;
    if(dsi_cfg.protocol_independent_bfm_enable == 1'b1)
    {
    (packet_direction == REVERSE) -> transmission_mode inside {LPDT, ULPM, TRIGGER};
    }
    else
    {
    (packet_direction == REVERSE) -> transmission_mode inside {LPDT, TRIGGER};
    }
    if(dsi_cfg.bta_enable == 1'b1)
    {
      bta_active != 2'b11;
    }
    else
    {
      bta_active == 2'h0;
    }
     if(transmission_mode == HS || transmission_mode == LPDT) {
      if(dsi_cfg.protocol_independent_bfm_enable) {
        if(packet_direction == FORWARD) {
          packet_kind == LONG;
          ecc_value == 8'h0;
          crc_value == 16'h0;
          forward_data_id == RESERVED;
          packet_type == NORMAL;
          vc_id == 0;
        }
 // Setting default values for Reverse BTA transactions.
        else if (packet_direction == REVERSE) {
          packet_kind == LONG;
          ecc_value == 8'h0;
          crc_value == 16'h0;
          reverse_data_id == RESERVED_RESP;
          packet_type == NORMAL;
          vc_id == 0;
        }
      }
      else {
        if(packet_direction == FORWARD) {
          if(dsi_cfg.phy_type == svt_mipi_dsi_configuration :: CPHY) {
            packet_kind == SHORT -> forward_data_id inside {
            VSYNC_START, VSYNC_END, HSYNC_START, HSYNC_END,
            COLOR_MODE_OFF, COLOR_MODE_ON, SHUT_DOWN, TURN_ON,
            GEN_WRITE0, GEN_WRITE1, GEN_WRITE2,
            GEN_READ0, GEN_READ1, GEN_READ2, DCS_WRITE0,
            DCS_WRITE1, DCS_READ0, SET_MAX_RTN_PKT_SIZE, COMPRESSION_MODE, EXECUTE_QUEUE, SCRAMBLING_MODE_COMMAND
          };
          }
          else if(dsi_cfg.dsi_protocol_version == svt_mipi_dsi_configuration::DSI2_VERSION_10 &&
                  dsi_cfg.phy_type == svt_mipi_dsi_configuration :: DPHY) {
            packet_kind == SHORT -> forward_data_id inside {
            VSYNC_START, VSYNC_END, HSYNC_START, HSYNC_END,
            COLOR_MODE_OFF, COLOR_MODE_ON, SHUT_DOWN, TURN_ON,
            GEN_WRITE0, GEN_WRITE1, GEN_WRITE2,
            GEN_READ0, GEN_READ1, GEN_READ2, EOTP,
            DCS_WRITE0, DCS_WRITE1, DCS_READ0, SET_MAX_RTN_PKT_SIZE, COMPRESSION_MODE, EXECUTE_QUEUE, SCRAMBLING_MODE_COMMAND
          };
          }
          else if(dsi_cfg.dsi_protocol_version == svt_mipi_dsi_configuration::DSI_VERSION_12 ||
                  dsi_cfg.dsi_protocol_version == svt_mipi_dsi_configuration::DSI_VERSION_13 ) {
            packet_kind == SHORT -> forward_data_id inside {
            VSYNC_START, VSYNC_END, HSYNC_START, HSYNC_END,
            COLOR_MODE_OFF, COLOR_MODE_ON, SHUT_DOWN, TURN_ON,
            GEN_WRITE0, GEN_WRITE1, GEN_WRITE2,
            GEN_READ0, GEN_READ1, GEN_READ2, EOTP,
            DCS_WRITE0, DCS_WRITE1, DCS_READ0, SET_MAX_RTN_PKT_SIZE, COMPRESSION_MODE, EXECUTE_QUEUE
          };
          }
          else {
            packet_kind == SHORT -> forward_data_id inside {
            VSYNC_START, VSYNC_END, HSYNC_START, HSYNC_END,
            COLOR_MODE_OFF, COLOR_MODE_ON, SHUT_DOWN, TURN_ON,
            GEN_WRITE0, GEN_WRITE1, GEN_WRITE2,
            GEN_READ0, GEN_READ1, GEN_READ2, EOTP,
            DCS_WRITE0, DCS_WRITE1, DCS_READ0, SET_MAX_RTN_PKT_SIZE
          };
          }
        }
        else {
          if(dsi_cfg.phy_type == svt_mipi_dsi_configuration :: CPHY) {
            packet_kind == SHORT -> reverse_data_id inside {
              ACK_WITH_ERR, GEN_SHORT_READ1_RESP, GEN_SHORT_READ2_RESP,
              DCS_SHORT_READ1_RESP, DCS_SHORT_READ2_RESP
            };
          }
          else {
            packet_kind == SHORT -> reverse_data_id inside {
              ACK_WITH_ERR, EOTP_RESP, GEN_SHORT_READ1_RESP, GEN_SHORT_READ2_RESP,
              DCS_SHORT_READ1_RESP, DCS_SHORT_READ2_RESP
            };
          }
        }
        if(dsi_cfg.phy_type == svt_mipi_dsi_configuration :: DPHY) {
          (packet_kind != SHORT || dsi_cfg.supported_vc_id[0] != 1'b1 || dsi_cfg.eotp_gen_enable != 1'b1) -> forward_data_id != EOTP;
        }
        if((dsi_cfg.dsi_protocol_version >= svt_mipi_dsi_configuration::DSI_VERSION_12) && (dsi_cfg.compression_enable == 1 || dsi_cfg.bypass_compression_enable == 1)) {
          (packet_kind == LONG && packet_direction == FORWARD) -> forward_data_id inside {
             NULL_PACKET, BLANKING_PACKET,
             COMPRESSED_IMAGE_DATA_TYPE,PICTURE_PARAMETER_SET
          };
        }
        else {
          (packet_kind == LONG && packet_direction == FORWARD) -> forward_data_id inside {
             GEN_LONG_WRITE, DCS_LONG_WRITE,
             PACKED_PIXEL_565, PACKED_PIXEL_888,
             PACKED_PIXEL_666, LOOSELY_PACKED_PIXEL_666,
             LOOSELY_PACKED_PIXEL_20BITS_YCBCR_422,
             PACKED_PIXEL_24BITS_YCBCR_422,
             PACKED_PIXEL_16BITS_YCBCR_422,
             PACKED_PIXEL_30BITS_RGB_101010,
             PACKED_PIXEL_36BITS_RGB_121212,
             PACKED_PIXEL_12BITS_YCBCR_420,
             NULL_PACKET, BLANKING_PACKET
          };
        }
         (packet_kind == LONG && packet_direction == REVERSE) -> reverse_data_id inside {
           DCS_LONG_READ_RESP, GEN_LONG_READ_RESP
        };
         if(dsi_cfg.dsi_protocol_version == svt_mipi_dsi_configuration::DSI2_VERSION_10){
          (forward_data_id == SCRAMBLING_MODE_COMMAND) -> data_word_count[15:1] == 'h0;
        }
        (//forward_data_id == VSYNC_START ||
         forward_data_id == VSYNC_END ||
         forward_data_id == HSYNC_START || forward_data_id == HSYNC_END ||
         forward_data_id == COLOR_MODE_OFF || forward_data_id == COLOR_MODE_ON ||
         forward_data_id == SHUT_DOWN || forward_data_id == TURN_ON) ->
        data_word_count == 16'h0;
          if(dsi_cfg.phy_type == svt_mipi_dsi_configuration :: DPHY) {
          forward_data_id == EOTP -> (data_word_count == 16'h0F0F && vc_id == 2'b00);
        }
         (forward_data_id == GEN_WRITE0 || forward_data_id == GEN_READ0) ->
        data_word_count[15:0] == 16'h0;
         (forward_data_id == GEN_WRITE1 || forward_data_id == GEN_READ1) ->
        data_word_count[15:8] == 8'h0;
         forward_data_id == DCS_WRITE0 -> data_word_count[7:0] inside {
           ENTER_IDLE_MODE, ENTER_INVERT_MODE, ENTER_PARTIAL_MODE,
           ENTER_NORMAL_MODE, ENTER_SLEEP_MODE, EXIT_IDLE_MODE,
           EXIT_INVERT_MODE, EXIT_SLEEP_MODE, NOP,
           SET_DISPLAY_OFF, SET_DISPLAY_ON, SET_TEAR_OFF, SOFT_RESET
        };
         forward_data_id == DCS_WRITE0 -> data_word_count[15:8] == 8'h0;
        forward_data_id == DCS_WRITE1 -> data_word_count[7:0] inside {
            SET_ADDRESS_MODE, SET_GAMMA_CURVE, SET_PIXEL_FORMAT, SET_TEAR_ON
        };
        forward_data_id == DCS_READ0 -> data_word_count[7:0] inside {
           GET_BLUE_CHANNEL, GET_ADDRESS_MODE, GET_DIAGNOSTIC_RESULT,
           GET_DISPLAY_MODE, GET_GREEN_CHANNEL, GET_PIXEL_FORMAT,
           GET_POWER_MODE, GET_RED_CHANNEL, GET_SCAN_LINE, GET_SIGNAL_MODE,
           READ_DDB_START, READ_DDB_CONTINUE,
           READ_MEMORY_START, READ_MEMORY_CONTINUE,
           GET_3D_CONTROL,GET_IMAGE_CHECKSUM_RGB
        };
         forward_data_id == DCS_READ0 -> data_word_count[15:8] == 8'h0;
         forward_data_id == PACKED_PIXEL_565 -> data_word_count % 2 == 0;
        forward_data_id == PACKED_PIXEL_666 -> data_word_count %9 == 0;
        (forward_data_id == PACKED_PIXEL_888 || forward_data_id == LOOSELY_PACKED_PIXEL_666)
        -> data_word_count % 3 == 0;
        (forward_data_id == LOOSELY_PACKED_PIXEL_20BITS_YCBCR_422 || forward_data_id == PACKED_PIXEL_24BITS_YCBCR_422)
          -> data_word_count % 6 == 0;
        forward_data_id == PACKED_PIXEL_16BITS_YCBCR_422 -> data_word_count % 4 == 0;
        forward_data_id == PACKED_PIXEL_12BITS_YCBCR_420 -> data_word_count % 3 == 0;
      }
    }
    else {
       if(transmission_mode == ULPM && dsi_cfg.protocol_independent_bfm_enable == 1'b0)
        {
          bta_active == 0;
        }
        packet_kind == SHORT ;
        data_word_count == 16'h0;
        ecc_value == 8'h0;
        crc_value == 16'h0;
        forward_data_id == RESERVED;
        reverse_data_id == RESERVED_RESP;
        packet_type == NORMAL;
        vc_id == 0;
       if(transmission_mode == INITIAL_SKEW || transmission_mode == PERIODIC_SKEW)
        {
          bta_active == 0;
          packet_direction == FORWARD;
          vc_id == 0;
        }
    }
     packet_kind == SHORT -> data_payload.size() == 0;
    packet_kind == LONG -> data_payload.size() == data_word_count;
     if(forward_data_id == VSYNC_START) {
      if(dsi_3d_payload_present == 1'b1) { data_word_count == {2'b00,dsi_3d_lr_order,dsi_3d_vsync_type,dsi_3d_image_format,dimensional_type,4'b0,dsi_3d_payload_present,3'b0};}
      else {data_word_count == 16'b0;}}
     alp_pause_wake_wire_state inside {[svt_mipi_cphy_types::PLUS_X:svt_mipi_cphy_types::MINUS_Z]};
  }
